title: Flaky CI tests after Redis upgrade
situation_md: Our checkout-service test suite started failing intermittently the morning after we upgraded shared Redis from 6 to 7. Pass rate dropped from 99 percent to about 80 percent overnight. The failures were not deterministic and not easily reproducible locally.
decision_md: I assigned each test suite a dedicated Redis logical DB index, with FLUSHDB on the per-suite index between tests. We had previously been sharing the default index and trusting per-key prefixes; that turned out to be insufficient under Redis 7's tighter eviction semantics.
outcome_md: Pass rate went 80 percent to 99.4 percent in 24 hours. Side note: a single shared FLUSHALL would have been faster to ship but worse for debuggability.
context_md: Team of 8, about 200 backend tests, GitHub Actions matrix with 4 parallel jobs.
